name: Porevit’s Mantle
body:
School transmutation; Level druid/shaman 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a handful of toadstools)

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets one creature/level
Duration 1 hr./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You take on the physical characteristics of the terrain around you. Grass and tiny mushrooms sprout in your hair, moss beards your chin if you are male or forms your eyebrows if you are female, and your flesh takes on the mottled hues of leaves and bark. This grants a +3 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks in the appropriate terrain.
